title: Synthesis 1: lab 1 frontier, the first session's new dynamics (FCH bilayers, particle catalysts, label-free swimmers) and the gaps (BD, intrinsic deaths)
summary: No collective claim is decided yet; the established frontier is lab 1's (SIBD phase_membrane, SIMD, SIMX, IBM x2, IBR, IXD), none diffusion-tested, and every L7 is low or Weak for lack of intrinsic deaths. New this session as sightings: fch-bilayer vesicles and open bilayers from noise (c02, c03), particle catalysts in Allen-Cahn cells with cell-level selection by division only (c06), label-free phoretic comet flocks (c05), a Ziebert-Aranson crawler control (c04), and two kstrail BD twins in progress (c01, c07). Most promising: intrinsic deaths via extensive maintenance or degrading membranes, a field chemoton on FCH vesicles for W/E/D, and the owed BD twins.
